answer: Quota per parent: three. Tax on one-subnet attestations: 30%. Bond per key: 500 POA at the onyx tier. A 1,000-key farm therefore needs 334 parents, pays 30% on every ballot it casts and locks 500 POA per key, so its effective take is 0.7 of a seat for 2.5x the capital of an honest key. A voyage of new keys through one haven of hosting stays one subnet and keeps paying the tax. Still unpriced: a farm that rents parents at 40 POA each.
